title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 4: Mephibosheth becomes lame, and Rechab and Baanah murder Ishbosheth and bring his head to David.

questions.text: How did Saul's son react when he heard that Abner was dead in Hebron?
questions.explanation: When Saul's son heard that Abner was dead, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

answers.text: He rejoiced and held a feast
He sent an army to Hebron

questions.text: What were the names of the two captains of raiding bands?
questions.explanation: Saul's son had two captains of raiding bands: Baanah and Rechab.

questions.text: Whose sons were the two captains?
questions.explanation: They were the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin.

questions.text: Where had the Beerothites fled to?
questions.explanation: The Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived as foreigners there until today.

questions.text: How old was Jonathan's son when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel?
questions.explanation: He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel.
His nurse picked him up and fled, and as she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame.

answers.text: He was wounded by a Philistine arrow
He fell as his nurse hurried to flee
He was born lame in both feet
A horse kicked him in the stable

questions.text: When did Rechab and Baanah come to the house of Ishbosheth?
questions.explanation: They came at about the heat of the day, as he took his rest at noon.

answers.text: At midnight, while he was asleep
At dawn, before he had risen
In the heat of the day, at his noon rest
In the evening, during a feast

questions.text: What did they pretend to do when they came into the middle of the house?
questions.explanation: They came into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat.

questions.text: What did David say he had done to the man who told him Saul was dead?
questions.explanation: David said he seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward he gave him for his news.

answers.text: He seized him and killed him in Ziklag
He gave him a large reward
He sent him back to the Philistines

questions.text: Where was the head of Ishbosheth buried?
questions.explanation: They took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner's grave in Hebron.
